_about: Data for tools/readme_images.py: the README's benchmark poster (docs/assets/benchmarks-*.webp) and header (docs/assets/header-*.svg).
A cell is {"value": tok/s, "method": speculative decoding method}, null (renders as a dash: not measured or not supported) or "x" (renders as ×: can't run that model on a Mac).
An engine whose numbers all share one method shows it under its name; otherwise each number shows its own. "todo" and "note" are never rendered; the script prints the todos.

Numbers: decode tok/s at T = 0.6 (docs/benchmarks.md, The README's tables; Flint at its card's T = 1.0, each of its cells the mean of that engine's 2026-10-22 runs, prefill and decode from the same runs), Kapitsa's KFlash runs on the M4 Pro as noted; "prefill" on a cell is the 4K-prompt reading speed from bench/results. Kapitsa's prefill is from its newest run without a contention or invalid flag (the M5 Max's Kapitsa and Splash cells are the exception: 2026-10-22 runs on main, each flagged for contention, Bolt's decode median including two repetition-loop runs), and its decode is the number in the cell's decode column; they can come from different runs (the M5 Pro's 27B cells, Kapitsa's and mlx-serve's, are the same 2026-10-22 interleaved pair on main, each the mean of its two runs, prefill and decode from those runs; the M5 Pro's 35B-A3B cell is its flag-free 2026-10-22 run on main 4b89f4e, the closing run of the Splash pair, prefill and decode together (its decode, 209, reads lower than d53f02e's single 217 run across three 4b89f4e runs; b07f274 read 197-204 the same morning, so no regression is established without an A/B), and its Lightning cell is a single 2026-10-21 run with prefill and decode together). The other engines' prefill is from the stored run closest to the decode value shown, flagged or not; the M5 Pro's Splash cells are each the mean of two 2026-10-22 runs between two Kapitsa runs (ABBA), every one flagged for contention, prefill and decode from those runs, except the 35B-A3B's decode, which is the loop-free run alone (the other run has a repetition-loop answer).

engines.name: Splash
engines.note: Inco AI's engine (incoai/splash). It runs only Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, each with its DFlash2 draft, and needs an M3 or newer.

engines.name: MLX
engines.note: Apple's mlx-lm or mlx-vlm, whichever runs the model faster

engines.name: rec
engines.note: Recursive's own engine for Flint (recursive-oss/rec: a Go launcher over rec-mlx, MLX 0.32 with a resident decode megakernel); it runs only Flint
